name: Waypoint, Ruled
tagline: The flight console ruled like a plate: day numerals in waypoint rings, square ticks for the family's hands, and four shapes with four jobs keyed in the footer.
concept: Waypoint Lamps, ruled like an engraved plate. The flight console keeps its instrument (the route over four weeks with each plan's day numeral in its waypoint ring, the same numeral leading its row and ringed in its month cell, the readout strip, the radar Next up tube, the needle meter) and clears its execution faults: every tick is now a square (the family's shape), one Plex Sans numeral serves ring, row and cell, read-only lists leave their slate bays for Backlit Plate's engraved rule heads on the ground, every inner page opens on Quote Board's head row (title, bone figure, stacked unit and change), To do carries Joined's lit NOW line as the route's grammar, and every tube's placard folds to Joined's one-line Ready foot. Dessau's shape law (ring = light or waypoint, square = the family's, bar = the page's, triangle = needs a look) is written at the top of the sheet and keyed in the footer. The light comes back where the phosphor is: the greeting's pool and scanlines spilling onto the strip, the lit 'plan', the breathing Today, Next, NOW and Ready lamps, the haloed Next leg.
companions: Slate (#111716) only where the family's hands go (the console, the filter racks, forms, settings panels); bone (#d9d2bb) for every figure that counts (head figures, the strip's figures, rule-head counts) and a bone lead (#b9b29c) on every rule head; pewter-bone (#c4c2b4, flown #6b665a dotted) for the route and the waypoint rings; steel (#6f8596, cap #a9c4d8) for 'here' and the setup line's bar; pewter for off; amber (#e3a651) only for late and needs a look, as the triangle, a row's 3px edge and words; the kind colours as 8px squares and a 13px kind word, Outing moved to a sage (#8fae86) so bright green is only the motif's.
